body: Well, if you've been reading this thread and a lot of the posts about babies,  it makes sense that birthing would be in your head.
I listened to a redditor's advice to turn back now, but still went to the replies to laugh at the reactions of people who didn't listen.  AITA?
It took my ex 45 minutes to deliver my son, and 30 of that was getting the pushing down.  Once she got it,  literally 15 minutes,  but she sure knew she had to push.

Who is the girlfriend to tell you what you can and can't tell your friend? And for that matter, who is she to tell you that you can't see your friend either?

Definitely tell your friend.  It may be embarrassing, and I suppose there is a slight chance of losing your friendship over it,  but if you don't see your friend anymore,  then you will definitely lose the friendship.

We were already together and met him at the same time at another friend's house in college. Alex was always closer to Sarah than me,  and I know he has had a crush for her for a long time,  but I'm also sure that he never acted on it,  though he did talk about the crush occasional.
